circuit:
* 2 MHz low-power relaxation oscillator (Sky130)
* f ~ (Ichg/Ilad)/(2*RB*C): thresholds VLO/VHI = Ilad*R from the external 2uA
* through a res_high_po ladder; timing cap is MiM. Bias magnitude and VDD
* cancel to first order; R and C models are typical at all named MOS corners.
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* ---- bias mirrors: N units 0.5uA (w=2 l=2), P units 0.25uA (w=4 l=2) ----
XMN0 IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=2 m=4
XCB IBN2U AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_2 w=22 l=22
XMN1 PB IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=2 m=2
XMP0 PB PB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=2 m=4

* ---- threshold ladder: 0.75uA -> VHI~0.6V, VLO~0.3V ----
XMP1 VHI PB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=2 m=3
XRB VHI VLO AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.35 l=441
XRA VLO AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.35 l=441

* ---- comparator stage 1: pmos-lvt pair, nmos mirror load ----
* COMP1 high when CT > VSEL
XMP2 TAIL PB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=2 m=3
XMPI1 N1 CT TAIL AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=4 l=0.5
XMPI2 COMP1 VSEL TAIL AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=4 l=0.5
XMNL1 N1 N1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=1
XMNL2 COMP1 N1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=1

* ---- comparator stage 2: rail-to-rail; COMP2 = not(COMP1) ----
XMN3 COMP2 COMP1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.3
XMP4 COMP2 PB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=2 m=2

* ---- logic: PHI high during discharge, PHIB is its complement ----
XMPA PHI COMP2 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XMNA PHI COMP2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15
XMPB PHIB PHI AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XMNB PHIB PHI AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15

* ---- hysteresis tap switches: charge phase selects VHI ----
XSWH VSEL PHIB VHI AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XSWL VSEL PHI VLO AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15

* ---- charge 1uA always on; discharge 2uA switched at mirror source ----
XMP3 CT PB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=2 m=4
XMN2 CT IBN2U SWN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=2 m=4
XSWD SWN PHI AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 m=2

* ---- timing capacitor ----
XC1 CT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_2 w=17.14 l=17.14

* ---- output buffer: CLKO = PHI ----
XMPC B1 PHI AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XMNC B1 PHI AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XMPD CLKO B1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15
XMND CLKO B1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15

.ends osc_2m

circuit:
* osc_2m -- 2 MHz low-power RC-astable oscillator (Sky130)
* Two-phase CMOS astable multivibrator:
*   G1: X->A (weak, ratiometric trip), G2: A->B, G3: B->D, G4: D->E
*   R: D->X (relaxation), C: E->X (regenerative coupling)
*   T ~ tau*[ln((a+k)/a)+ln((1+k-a)/(1-a))] with tau=R*(C+Cpar), a=trip/VDD.
*   Thresholds ratio to VDD -> first-order supply-independent frequency.
* R = series res_high_po (tc1>0, D side) + res_xhigh_po (tc1<0, X side);
*   blend ratio nulls temperature drift; R/C typical at tt/ss/ff corners.
* IBN2U: terminated in diode mirror; keeper on B bounds startup ambiguity.
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U
* bias termination and startup keeper
XMB IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMK b IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=0.42 nf=1
* G1: timing comparator inverter (LVT: keeps gain at ss/cold/low-VDD trip)
XMP1 a x AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN1 a x AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=0.42 nf=1
* G2: sharpener (LVT)
XMP2 b a AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN2 b a AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=0.42 nf=1
* G3: drives timing resistor
XMP3 d b AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMN3 d b AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
* G4: drives timing capacitor
XMP4 e d AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMN4 e d AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* timing network: D --RH-- rm --RX-- X, C from E to X
XRH d rm AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.35 l=755
XRX rm x AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=32.6
XCT x e sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=10 mf=1
* output buffer to CLKO (1 pF load)
XMP5 f e AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN5 f e AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP6 CLKO f AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XMN6 CLKO f AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
.ends osc_2m

circuit:
* 2 MHz low-power oscillator - sky130 - 555-style RC relaxation
* Architecture:
*  - res_xhigh_po divider makes VRH=2/3*VDD, VRL=1/3*VDD (ratiometric refs)
*  - res_high_po (low tempco) charges MIM cap between VRH/VRL -> T ~ 2*ln2*R*C
*  - two 1uA comparators (biased from 2uA input mirror) + NOR latch + buffers
*  - frequency to first order independent of supply and MOS corner
* Only bin-validated unit geometries are used; larger devices via m= multiples.
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* ---------------- bias: terminate 2uA input, mirror to comparator tails
XMB0 IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1 m=2
XMB1 TH    IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMB2 PBD   IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMPD PBD   PBD   AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMPT TL    PBD   AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1 m=2

* ---------------- threshold divider 1/3 - 2/3 VDD, MIM decoupled taps
XRD1 AVDD VRH AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=420
XRD2 VRH  VRL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=420
XRD3 VRL  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=420
XCD1 VRH AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=10 mf=1
XCD2 VRL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=10 mf=1

* ---------------- timing RC
XRT DRV CT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.5 l=725
XCT CT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=15.8 l=15.8 mf=1

* ---------------- comparator HI (NMOS pair): OH goes low when CT > VRH
XN1 A1 VRH TH AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1 m=5
XN2 OH CT  TH AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1 m=5
XP1 A1 A1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1 m=2
XP2 OH A1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1 m=2
* P-skewed low-crowbar inverter (long L, tiny) -> RST active high
XIH1P RST OH AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XIH1N RST OH AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1

* ---------------- comparator LO (PMOS pair): OL goes high when CT < VRL
XP3 A2 VRL TL AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1 m=10
XP4 OL CT  TL AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1 m=10
XN3 A2 A2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XN4 OL A2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
* N-skewed low-crowbar inverter (long L, tiny) then standard inverter -> SET
XIL1P SB OL AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1
XIL1N SB OL AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XIL2P SET SB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIL2N SET SB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------- NOR latch: Q high = charge phase
* NOR1: Q = NOR(RST, QB)
XL1P1 M1 RST AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XL1P2 Q  QB  M1   AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XL1N1 Q  RST AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XL1N2 Q  QB  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* NOR2: QB = NOR(SET, Q)
XL2P1 M2 SET AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XL2P2 QB Q   M2   AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XL2N1 QB SET AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XL2N2 QB Q   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------- driver buffer for timing R: DRV = buffer(Q)
XID1P QD1 Q   AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XID1N QD1 Q   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XID2P DRV QD1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=2
XID2N DRV QD1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1

* ---------------- output buffer to CLKO (1 pF load)
XIO1P O1 QB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIO1N O1 QB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XIO2P O2 O1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=2
XIO2N O2 O1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XIO3P CLKO O2 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=4
XIO3N CLKO O2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=2

.ends osc_2m

circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* osc_2m : 2 MHz low-power current-mode relaxation oscillator (Sky130)
*
* Half period = R * C, set by a temperature-compensated poly resistor and a
* MIM capacitor, so it is independent of AVDD and of the absolute bias level.
*
*   - The external 2 uA on IBN2U sets an NMOS mirror reference.  All mirror
*     devices are integer multiples (m=) of one identical unit transistor so
*     that every ratio is exact and immune to BSIM4 width/length binning.
*   - One unit PMOS current (I) develops the threshold VREF = I*R across the
*     resistor; two more identical unit PMOS currents charge C_A and C_B.
*     Half period = C*VREF/I = R*C: the bias current cancels.
*   - R is a series combination of res_high_po (tc1 = +514 ppm/C) and
*     res_xhigh_po (tc1 = -1470 ppm/C).  The MIM capacitor has tc1 = tc2 = 0,
*     so the resistor ratio sets the whole R*C temperature coefficient.  It
*     is set slightly positive (about +300 ppm/C, 13% xhigh) rather than
*     nulled, so that the growth of R*C with temperature cancels the
*     comparator propagation delay, which shrinks as temperature rises.
*   - Two PMOS-input comparators and a NOR set/reset latch alternate the two
*     ramps.  The NOR pull-ups are deliberately asymmetric, so power-up
*     cannot rest on the latch metastable point.
*   - CLKO is a rail-to-rail CMOS buffer, so the swing equals AVDD.
*
* All transistor geometries are exact model bin points.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Comparator: PMOS input pair, NMOS mirror load, output inverter.
* OUT is high when V(VN) > V(VP).  Tail = 4 unit currents.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt oscmp AVDD AVSS PB VP VN OUT
XMT  TAIL PB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4    w=5    nf=1 m=4
XMI1 N1   VP TAIL AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=1    nf=1
XMI2 N2   VN TAIL AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=1    nf=1
XML1 N1   N1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1    w=1    nf=1
XML2 N2   N1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1    w=1    nf=1
XIN  OUT  N2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XIP  OUT  N2 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.55 nf=1
.ends oscmp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U
* ----- NMOS reference: 2 uA in, unit = 0.25 uA -----
XM0 IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=1 nf=1 m=8
XM1 PGATE IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=1 nf=1

* ----- PMOS mirror reference -----
XMP0 PGATE PGATE AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=5 nf=1

* ----- Threshold branch: VREF = I * R, R is TC compensated -----
XMPR VREF PGATE AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=5 nf=1
XRH1 VREF RM1  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po  w=0.5 l=795.39
XRH2 RM1  RM2  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po  w=0.5 l=795.39
XRX1 RM2  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.5 l=33.812
XCREF VREF AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=16 l=16

* ----- Ramp capacitors, charge sources and reset switches -----
XMPA VCA PGATE AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=5 nf=1
XMPB VCB PGATE AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=5 nf=1
XCA  VCA AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=9.76 l=9.76
XCB  VCB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=9.76 l=9.76
XRSA VCA Q    AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XRSB VCB QBUF AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
* QBUF = NOT Q.  Deriving the second reset from Q itself (instead of from
* the latch node QB) makes the two resets strictly complementary, so one
* ramp is always held low.  That removes the NOR latch illegal state
* (CMPA = CMPB = 1 would otherwise leave both ramps free and latch up) and
* makes power-up start deterministically.
XNIN QBUF Q AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XNIP QBUF Q AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1    nf=1

* ----- Comparators -----
XCPA AVDD AVSS PGATE VREF VCA CMPA oscmp
XCPB AVDD AVSS PGATE VREF VCB CMPB oscmp

* ----- NOR set/reset latch: Q = NOR(CMPB,QB), QB = NOR(CMPA,Q) -----
* NOR A has the stronger pull-up, so power-up resolves to Q = 1.
XNAP1 NA1 CMPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1    nf=1
XNAP2 Q   QB   NA1  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1    nf=1
XNAN1 Q   CMPB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XNAN2 Q   QB   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XNBP1 NB1 CMPA AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.55 nf=1
XNBP2 QB  Q    NB1  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.55 nf=1
XNBN1 QB  CMPA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XNBN2 QB  Q    AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* ----- Output buffer -----
XB1N BUF1 Q    AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XB1P BUF1 Q    AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1    nf=1
XB2N CLKO BUF1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XB2P CLKO BUF1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3    nf=1
.ends osc_2m

circuit:
* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* osc_2m -- ~2 MHz uncalibrated low-power oscillator, SKY130 devices only
*
* Topology: three-stage RC ring.  Each stage is
*     RC node -> LVT receiver inverter -> minimum-length driver inverter
*             -> series resistor -> shunt MIM capacitor -> next RC node
* with one extra driver inverter in stage 3 so the loop carries an odd
* number (7) of inversions.
*
* Why the period is PVT stable
*  - The time constant is set by PDK poly resistors and MIM capacitors.
*    In this PDK the tt/ss/ff sections all load res_typical__cap_typical,
*    so R and C carry no process spread; the MIM cap additionally has
*    tc1 = tc2 = 0.
*  - Each stage resistor is a series composite of res_xhigh_po
*    (tc1 = -1.47e-3 /C) and res_high_po (tc1 = +0.514e-3 /C) in a 1:3
*    resistance ratio, which cancels the first-order tempco; the residual
*    drift of the composite over -40..85 C is under +-0.5%.
*  - A ring uses both edges of every node, so the period depends on the
*    receiver trip point a = Vtrip/VDD only through ln(1/(a*(1-a))), which
*    is stationary at a = 0.5.  LVT devices trip at a = 0.48..0.53 over the
*    five PVT points, so trip-point drift contributes about 1% and the
*    period tracks R*C rather than supply, threshold voltage or mobility.
*  - The receiver sees the slow RC ramp and is therefore the only crowbar
*    path.  LVT keeps it responsive at ss/1.62V/-40C, where standard-Vt
*    devices carry only ~30 nA at their trip point and stall the loop; the
*    long L = 2 channel and narrow p device keep its crowbar charge small.
*    The driver inverters see fast edges and cost almost nothing.
*  - CLKO is buffered from a full-swing internal node, so the output is
*    rail-to-rail into the 1 pF load.
*
* IBN2U is the 2 uA bias input; it is terminated in a diode-connected NMOS
* that gives the pin a defined low-impedance DC sink.  The frequency is
* referenced to R*C and not to that current, which is what makes it
* insensitive to supply and to transistor parameters.
*
* Measured over the five declared PVT points: 1.929..2.056 MHz, output
* swing 1.000..1.0003 x VDD, and 16.4 uW at tt/1.80V/27C.
*
* Pin order: AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U
* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U
*
* --- 2 uA bias input termination -----------------------------------------
XMB0 IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
*
* --- stage 1 : RC node NA -> receiver -> driver -> R -> NB ---------------
XA1N P1 NA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=0.42 nf=1
XA1P P1 NA AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=0.63 nf=1
XD1N O1 P1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XD1P O1 P1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.05 nf=1
XR1A O1 J1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=33.5
XR1B J1 NB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po  w=0.35 l=761
XQ1  NB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=4.73 l=4.73
*
* --- stage 2 : RC node NB -> receiver -> driver -> R -> NC ---------------
XA2N P2 NB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=0.42 nf=1
XA2P P2 NB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=0.63 nf=1
XD2N O2 P2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* ===================================================================
* osc_2m : 2 MHz low-power RC-referenced relaxation oscillator
*          sky130, external 2 uA bias on IBN2U, 1 pF load on CLKO
*
* Principle
*   The external 2 uA programs an NMOS master bias.  A PMOS mirror
*   makes matched copies: I_R = 0.25 uA is pushed through a grounded
*   poly-resistor string (V_L = I_R*RL, V_H = I_R*(RL+R2)) and
*   I_up = 0.5 uA charges a MIM capacitor.  A switched 1.0 uA NMOS
*   sink gives -0.5 uA net on the down ramp, so VC is a symmetric
*   triangle between V_L and V_H at
*
*        f = 1 / ( 2*(I_R/I_up)*R2*C + 2*td ) = 1 / ( R2*C + 2*td )
*
*   The absolute bias current and VDD both cancel: only the mirror
*   ratio (exact, built from parallel unit devices), R2 and C set the
*   frequency.  sky130 uses the same R/C models in tt/ss/ff and the
*   MIM cap has tc1=tc2=0, so the sole analog drift left is the poly
*   tempco, which is nulled by mixing the two poly flavours below.
*
* Design rules used here
*   - Every mirror ratio is built from PARALLEL COPIES of one unit
*     device (l=2 w=1 nf=1).  The BSIM4 models are narrowly binned, so
*     scaling a mirror by w or nf would move it to a different model
*     bin and destroy the ratio.
*   - All geometries sit on a modeled bin: l in {0.15,0.25,0.5,1,2},
*     w/nf in {1,2,3,5}.
*   - V_H is kept near 0.5 V so the PMOS-input comparators keep tail
*     headroom at the 1.62 V / -40 C / ss stress point.
* ===================================================================
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* ------------- NMOS master bias : 2 uA = 8 unit legs of 0.25 uA ----
XMN0A IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMN0B IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMN0C IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMN0D IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMN0E IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMN0F IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMN0G IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMN0H IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
* 0.25 uA leg that programs the PMOS mirror
XMN1  NPB   IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
* 1.0 uA discharge sink = 4 unit legs (net -0.5 uA on VC when QD=1)
XMN2A NDS   IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMN2B NDS   IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMN2C NDS   IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMN2D NDS   IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMS   VC    QD    NDS  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* ------------- PMOS mirror : unit leg = 0.25 uA --------------------
XMP0  NPB NPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
* I_R : 1 unit -> threshold string
XMP1  VRT NPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
* I_up : 2 units -> timing capacitor
XMP2A VC  NPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMP2B VC  NPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
* comparator tails : 4 units = 1.0 uA each
XMP3A TLH NPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMP3B TLH NPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMP3C TLH NPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMP3D TLH NPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMP4A TLL NPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMP4B TLL NPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMP4C TLL NPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XMP4D TLL NPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1

* ------------- Threshold string : VRT = V_H, VRM = V_L -------------
* R2 = 1.199 M (VRT..VRM) sets dV = 0.300 V ; RL = 0.800 M sets
* V_L = 0.200 V.  Each leg is 74 % res_high_po (tc1 = +514u/K) and
* 26 % res_xhigh_po (tc1 = -1470u/K) so its net tempco is nulled.

XR2 RA1 RA2  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po  w=0.5 l=680
XR3 RA2 VRM  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1   l=147
XR4 VRM RB1  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po  w=0.5 l=453
XR5 RB1 RB2  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po  w=0.5 l=453
XR6 RB2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1   l=98

* ------------- Timing capacitor ------------------------------------
XC1 VC AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=12.4 l=12.4

* ------------- Upper comparator : CHB high when VC > V_H -----------
XCH1 CHA VC  TLH AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XCH2 CHB VRT TLH AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XCH3 CHA CHA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XCH4 CHB CHA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XIH1 SN CHB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1 nf=1
XIH2 SN CHB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1 nf=1

* ------------- Lower comparator : CLB high when VC < V_L -----------
XCL1 CLA VRM TLL AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XCL2 CLB VC  TLL AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XCL3 CLA CLA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XCL4 CLB CLA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XIL1 RN CLB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1 nf=1
XIL2 RN CLB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1 nf=1

* ------------- NAND SR latch : QD = 1 -> discharge -----------------
XNA1 QD  SN N1A AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNA2 N1A QN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

XNB4 QN  QD AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* ------------- Output buffer ---------------------------------------
XB1N B1 QD AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XB1P B1 QD AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* reference: Iref through R from AVDD -> VRF = AVDD - Iref*R

XRX AVDD RM AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=39.1

* =====================================================================
* 2 MHz low-power relaxation oscillator (Sky130 PDK devices only)
*
* Architecture: RC relaxation oscillator with ratiometric thresholds.
*  - The forced 2 uA into IBN2U develops VGS on diode XMB; NMOS tails
*    XTH/XTL mirror it to bias two NMOS-input comparators.
*  - Comparator H (YH high when VB > VTH = 0.80*VDD) and comparator L
*    (YL high when VB < VTL = 0.55*VDD) drive a NAND latch.
*  - Latch output Q gates charge switch XP1 (VDD -> NA) and discharge
*    switch XN1 (ND -> AVSS). CT at VB ramps through RA (charge) and
*    RB (discharge) between the two divider taps.
*  - Frequency = 1/((ln((1-vl)/(1-vh)))*RA*CB + (ln(vh/vl))*RB*CB).
*    Both the ramp current and the thresholds track VDD, so supply
*    cancels; only poly R (corner-typical, ~+0.5e-3/C) and MIM C
*    (tc=0) set frequency across PVT.
* =====================================================================

* ---- tiny logic gates (fixed geometry; numeric literals only) ----
.subckt o_inv_a IN OUT VDD VSS
XMP OUT IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMN OUT IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends o_inv_a

.subckt o_inv_b IN OUT VDD VSS
XMP OUT IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMN OUT IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends o_inv_b

.subckt o_inv_c IN OUT VDD VSS
XMP OUT IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMN OUT IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends o_inv_c

.subckt o_nand2 A B OUT VDD VSS
XMP1 NET1 A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XMP2 OUT  B NET1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XMN1 OUT  A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XMN2 OUT  B VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends o_nand2

* 2 MHz low-power oscillator: bias-referenced relaxation (555-style).

* divider. Two comparators with tails mirrored from the external 2 uA
* bias sink drive a NAND SR latch, so the switching delay is set by the
* reference current rather than by MOS drive strength. Exponential
* crossings at fixed rail fractions make the period
* 2*ln(0.65/0.35)*R_T*C_T supply- and corner-independent to first order.
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

XMB0 IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=8 l=4

XML6 pb1 pb1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=4
XML5 taill pb1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=13.5 l=4

* ---- threshold divider: R1:R2:R3 = 1M:857k:1M -> V_H=0.65, V_L=0.35 ----

XD2 vh vl AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.35 l=877
XD3 vl AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.35 l=1023

XMH1 dh vc tailh AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.5
XMH2 outh vh tailh AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.5

XML2 outl vc taill AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.5

circuit:
* 2 MHz low-power relaxation oscillator (sky130).
*
* Architecture: two alternating timing caps are charged from ground by
* mirrored copies of the external 2 uA bias.  A cap trips a comparator when
* it reaches V(VREF) = I_REF * R_REF, where I_REF is a matched copy of the
* same charging current, so each half period equals R_REF * C_x and the
* supply voltage cancels to first order.  The reference resistor is a
* res_high_po + res_xhigh_po series stack whose opposite linear tempcos
* cancel.  An SR latch alternates the ground reset switches; CLKO is a
* buffered latch output swinging rail to rail.

.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* ---- bias: external 2 uA into NMOS diode at IBN2U ----
XND IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
* PMOS mirror reference: mirrored NMOS sink loads a diode pfet -> VPB
XN2 VPB IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.6 nf=1
XPB VPB VPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1

* ---- threshold reference: PMOS mirror current into R_REF ----
XPR VREF VPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XRH VREF NRM AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=1944
XRX NRM AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=102

* ---- timing caps, chargers, ground reset switches ----
XCA CA AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=9.9
XCB CB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=15.0
XPCA CA VPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XPCB CB VPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XSWA CA Q AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSWB CB QB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---- comparators: cap ramp vs VREF, active-low trip output ----
XCMPA CA VREF VPB AVDD AVSS NA osc_cmp
XCMPB CB VREF VPB AVDD AVSS NB osc_cmp

* ---- SR latch: Q high holds cap A at 0 while cap B times ----
XNDA NA QB Q AVDD AVSS osc_nand2
XNDB NB Q QB AVDD AVSS osc_nand2

* ---- output buffer ----
XBUF1 Q BP1 AVDD AVSS osc_inv_m
XBUF2 BP1 BP2 AVDD AVSS osc_inv_b
XBUF3 BP2 CLKO AVDD AVSS osc_inv_o
.ends osc_2m

* Comparator: stage 1 is a PMOS-input diff pair with an NMOS-mirror load

XM1 N1 INP S1 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

XM5 O2 O1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XM8 O2 VPB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1

circuit:
* 2 MHz low-power oscillator
* Current driven relaxation oscillator:
*   IBN2U (2 uA) -> NMOS bias -> PMOS bias PB.
*   PMOS mirror pushes Iref into a poly resistor: VREF = Iref*R.
*   PMOS mirror charges the MIM timing cap with Ichg; when VCAP crosses
*   VREF comparator C1 trips and the reset switch dumps the cap.
*   A second comparator C2 watches the same ramp against VREF/2 and
*   squares it up into CLKO, so the output has a near 50% duty cycle and
*   both phases are hundreds of ns long (needed to swing the 1 pF load).
*   Period ~ C*(VREF-Vlow)/Ichg = (Iref/Ichg)*R*C  -> first order
*   independent of VDD and of the absolute bias current.
* Mirror ratios are built from identical parallel unit devices so that the
* ratio is exact despite the PDK's strong width dependent Vth.

circuit:
* 2 MHz low-power relaxation oscillator.
*
* VCAP is discharged from AVDD by I_chg and reset to AVDD by a PMOS.
* Trip threshold is set by a current through XRV:
*   reset off : VTRIP = AVDD - (I_trip + I_hys)*R   (low threshold)
*   reset on  : VTRIP = AVDD -  I_trip         *R   (high threshold)
* VCAP swings between those levels (swing = I_hys*R) and the loop regenerates.
* f = I_chg/(C*I_hys*R), set only by R and C (neither varies with tt/ff/ss).
*
* R is kept small (~90k) so the VTRIP node RC is fast enough for the threshold
* to jump inside the reset window. Current mirrors use long channels (l=4)
* at a real inversion level so ratios track across VDS and temperature.
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* ---- Bias input diode: the bench forces 2uA into IBN2U ----
XMD   IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=8 nf=1

* ---- Timing-cap discharge current (I_chg = 1uA, 1:2) ----
XMCH  VCAP  IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=4 nf=1

* ---- Trip-current sink (I_trip ~= 0.2uA) ----
XMTR  VTRIP IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=1 nf=1

* ---- Hysteresis current sink (I_hys ~= 2uA), on only while reset is off ----
XMHYSC VHYSC IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=8 nf=1
XMHYSW VTRIP RSTG  VHYSC AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* ---- Swing resistor: AVDD - VTRIP = (I_trip + I_hys)*R ----

circuit:
* 2 MHz low-power oscillator
* Interface: AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U   (IBN2U sinks the external 2 uA)
*
* Architecture
*   - bias: the forced 2 uA into an NMOS diode, plus a high-po poly resistor
*     from AVDD into the same diode.  The resistor current (AVDD-Vgs)/R makes
*     the mirrored ring current track AVDD, partly compensating the C*dV/I
*     ring delay, and the poly tempco largely cancels the Vgs drift of the
*     diode, so the frequency is nearly flat over -40..85 C.
*   - matching: at a few uA/square the mirrors sit in moderate inversion,
*     where a few tens of mV of Vth offset multiplies the ratio.  Every
*     mirror device therefore uses the same channel length, the same
*     per-finger width (w/nf = 0.42) and the same current density; all
*     ratios come from `nf` alone.  The pfet sources are biased by a pfet
*     diode carrying the reference current, so their |Vgs| is set by the
*     current they must pass, not by an nmos level shift.
*   - core: 3-stage current-starved ring; the starving sources bound every
*     crowbar current.  MIM timing caps (zero tempco, corner independent)
*     set the delay, T = N*C*VDD/I.
*   - output: weak long-channel inverter sharpens the slow ring edge with
*     little crowbar, then a small rail-to-rail driver into CLOAD.
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
XR1   AVDD IBN2U AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=1800

XMPB  nbp   nbp   AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=0.42 nf=1

XS1N  n1   n3    na1  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1    nf=1
XN1   na1  IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2   w=0.42 nf=1
XC1   n1   AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=6 l=6 mf=1

* ---------------- ring stage 2 : n1 -> n2 ----------------
XP2   pa2  nbp   AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2   w=0.42 nf=1
XS2P  n2   n1    pa2  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1    nf=1
XS2N  n2   n1    na2  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1    nf=1

circuit:
* Low-power 2 MHz relaxation oscillator around an external 2uA bias current.
*
* Principle: every internal current is an NMOS mirror of the external 2 uA on
* IBN2U (diode-input current mirror), timing is set by a MIM capacitor, and
* the trip threshold is the I*R drop of a poly resistor.  Because the corner
* kit uses "typical" R/C models for every process corner, the R*C product is
* essentially corner independent.  The current ratios (charging vs.
* hysteresis) are set by device geometry, so the oscillation frequency
*
*     f ~ (I_charge / I_hyst) / (R * C)
*
* is nearly independent of VDD and of the magnitude/corner of the bias.
*
* Timing node ncap holds a MIM capacitor from AVDD to x; an NMOS current sink
* pulls a fixed current out of x, so ncap ramps DOWN from AVDD.  The reference
* node vr is an I*R drop below AVDD.  A differential pair compares ncap with vr,
* and a PMOS reset switch pulls ncap back up; a gated hysteresis current shifts
* vr between a high threshold (reset phase) and a low threshold (ramp phase),
* which produces two well-separated trip points and a clean sawtooth.
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U
* --- bias input: diode NMOS takes the 2 uA, gate is the mirror reference ---
XMN0 IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.0 l=2 nf=1

* --- reference drop:  vr = AVDD - I_ref * R_ref  (I_ref = 1 uA) -----------
XMNX4 vr IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=2 nf=1
XRREF AVDD vr AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=1250

* --- timing: cap from AVDD to ncap, I_charge = 1 uA sinks -> ncap ramps down -----
XMNX5 ncap IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=2 nf=1
XCMIN ncap AVDD sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=25 l=25 mf=1

* --- hysteresis: extra sink out of vr during the ramp phase ----------------
XMNX6 mid IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=2 nf=1
XMNSW vr nr mid AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.0 l=0.15 nf=1

* --- comparator: diff pair M6(ncap)/M7(vr), tail M8, PMOS mirror load ----------
* out1 is HIGH when ncap < vr.
XMN6 out1 ncap tail AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.0 l=1 nf=1
XMN7 rb  vr tail AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.0 l=1 nf=1
XMN8 tail IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=2 nf=1
XMP9 rb rb AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2.0 l=1 nf=2
XMP10 out1 rb AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2.0 l=1 nf=2

* --- reset: PMOS recharges ncap upward when out1 is high (nr low) -------------
XMPR ncap nr AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.5 nf=2

* --- logic: nr = !out1, drives reset PMOS and hysteresis switch ------------
XMN11 nr out1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15 nf=1
XMP11 nr out1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1.0 l=0.15 nf=1

* --- output buffer: two inverters to rail-to-rail CLKO ----------------------
XMN21 a nr AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15 nf=1
XMP21 a nr AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1.0 l=0.15 nf=1
XMN22 CLKO a AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15 nf=1
XMP22 CLKO a AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3.0 l=0.15 nf=2
.ends osc_2m

circuit:
* 2 MHz low-power relaxation oscillator for Sky130, biased from a 2 uA input.
*
* Topology: a single MIM capacitor is alternately charged and discharged at a
* well-defined current between two current-referenced trip levels.  The trip
* levels VLO and VHI are made from the same bias current flowing through a
* poly-resistor ladder, so the charge/discharge sweep time equals the R*C
* product and is nominally independent of the exact bias current value.
*
* Reference ladder: the 1 uA unit current Iss flows from AVDD through a PMOS
* source, then R1 (VHI-VLO) and R2 (VLO-GND), then to a mirror sink.
* VLO = Iss*R2, VHI = Iss*(R1+R2).
*
* Single cap X on node x: charged at Iss by an always-on PMOS source, and
* discharged at net Iss by an NMOS sink carrying 2*Iss (so net out = Iss while
* the source is still on).  Two PMOS-input comparators compare x with VHI and
* VLO; a cross-coupled NOR latch steers the discharge switch, and a CMOS
* buffer drives CLKO.
*
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias: diode NMOS sinks the incoming 2 uA, sets common gate node IBN2U.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMBN IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2

* PMOS mirror reference: diode PMOS from AVDD carrying 0.5 uA, and an NMOS
* sink carrying 0.5 uA (a quarter of the input).  All PMOS mirrors use 2*x
* width for 2*Iss, i.e. the 1 uA unit current used by the timing network,
* aligned with the XMBN current scale.
XMPD pb pb AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=2
XMPDN pb IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reference ladder producing VHI and VLO.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XLAD vhi pb AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XR1 vhi vlo AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=786
XR2 vlo AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=786

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Timing capacitor and its charge / discharge current sources.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XC x AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22 l=23 mf=1
XPCHG x pb AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMDIS x gdis AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2
XSWA IBN2U qd gdis AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSWB gdis qb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Comparator 1: x vs VHI.  Output s (active high) when x > VHI.
* PMOS input pair with NMOS current-mirror load.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XC1TAIL cs1 pb AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2.4 nf=2
XC1P1 oc1x x cs1 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=2
XC1P2 oc1r vhi cs1 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=2
XC1N1 oc1x oc1x AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XC1N2 oc1r oc1x AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XC1I1 oc1b oc1r AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=2
XC1N3 oc1b oc1r AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XC1I2 s oc1b AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=2
XC1N4 s oc1b AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

XC2P1 oc2x x cs2 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=2
XC2P2 oc2r vlo cs2 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=2

* 2 MHz RC relaxation oscillator (Sky130, physical poly-R + MIM-C)
* Schmitt trigger provides VDD-proportional hysteresis; R*C sets the period.
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* ---- Bias: diode NMOS sinks the external 2 uA reference ----

* ---- Schmitt trigger (6T), input ncap, output schout ----
* pull-up: VDD -[M1]- px -[M2 || M3]- schout
* pull-down: schout -[M4 || M6]- ny -[M5]- GND

XSP2 schout ncap  px   AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

XSN1 ny     ncap  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

XSN3 schout schout ny   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

circuit:
* 2 MHz low-power current-mode relaxation oscillator.
*
* An external 2 uA bias current is sunk by the diode-connected master XM0,
* which sets the mirror gate node IBN2U.  All internal currents are mirrors
* of that bias, so the charging current and the threshold currents share the
* same master.  The timing capacitor XC is charged by the PMOS mirror XPC
* and discharged by the gated NMOS mirror XDI.  Its swing is bounded by the
* two resistor-derived thresholds vrefh/vrefl:
*     vrefl = I*RL ,  vrefh = I*(RL+RH)  (I = 0.5 uA mirror current)
* so  Dv = vrefh - vrefl = I*RH, and the frequency is
*     f = I/(2*C*Dv) = 1/(2*RH*C)
* i.e. set only by the PDK high-poly timing resistor and the MIM capacitor.
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias master: diode-connected NMOS sinks the external 2 uA.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XM0 IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.84 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* PMOS gate node vbp: an NMOS mirror (0.5 uA) pulls current through the
* diode-connected PMOS XPD.  vbp then drives all PMOS current sources.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XIS vbp IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3.36 w=0.84 nf=1
XPD vbp vbp AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.68 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* PMOS current sources (gate = vbp, source = AVDD).
* XPC  : timing-capacitor charge current       (0.5 uA).
* XLD  : reference-ladder top current          (0.5 uA).
* XTA/XTB : comparator tail currents           (0.125 uA each).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XPC vpc   vbp AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.68 nf=1
XLD vrefh vbp AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.68 nf=1
XTA vta   vbp AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.42 nf=1
XTB vtb   vbp AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.42 nf=1
* Charge switch: connects the charge source to vc only while q=0
* (charge phase); during discharge (q=1) it is open so the cap is
* drained at a full I_discharge instead of being fought by the source.
XQSW vc q vpc AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS current mirrors (gate = IBN2U).
* XDI : discharge sink (0.5 uA), attached to vc through the switch XDSW
*       when the latch output q is high.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XDI vdi IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3.36 w=0.84 nf=1
XDSW vc q vdi AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reference ladder: high-poly resistors in series, grounded at the
* bottom.  The top current XLD sets the tap voltages vrefh / vrefl.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XRL vrefl AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=3900
XRH vrefh vrefl AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=1900

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Timing capacitor (MIM) on the charge node.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XC vc AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=15 l=15 mf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Comparator CMP_H: cmph is high when vc > vrefh.
* PMOS input pair with current-mirror (active) NMOS loads.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XPH1 cmph  vrefh vta AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1.68 nf=1
XPH2 cmph2 vc    vta AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1.68 nf=1
XNH3 cmph2 cmph2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=0.84 nf=1
XNH4 cmph  cmph2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=0.84 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Comparator CMP_L: cmpl is high when vc < vrefl.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XPL1 cmpl  vc    vtb AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1.68 nf=1
XPL2 cmpl2 vrefl vtb AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1.68 nf=1
XNL3 cmpl2 cmpl2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=0.84 nf=1
XNL4 cmpl  cmpl2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=0.84 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* SR latch (cross-coupled NOR): cmph sets q, cmpl resets q.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XNS1 qb cmph AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNS2 qb q    AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XPS1 qb cmph nps  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XPS2 nps q    AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XNR1 q  cmpl AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNR2 q  qb   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XPR1 q  cmpl npr  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XPR2 npr qb   AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Output buffer: qb inverted to pb, then a final inverter to CLKO.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XB1 pb   qb  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=1
XB2 pb   qb  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=1
XB3 CLKO pb  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=1
XB4 CLKO pb  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.4 nf=1

.ends osc_2m

circuit:
* 2 MHz low-power relaxation oscillator (Sky130)
* Interface: AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U  (IBN2U sinks 2uA bias)
*
* Architecture:
*   - IBN2U feeds a diode-connected NMOS biased at its zero-temperature
*     coefficient (ZTC) point -> VREF ~= 0.92 V, stable over temperature.
*   - A PMOS current source (mirrored from VREF) charges a MIM cap.
*   - An NMOS-input current-mirror comparator trips when CAP crosses VREF,
*     then resets the cap, producing a free-running sawtooth oscillator.
*   - The comparator output is buffered to drive CLKO rail-to-rail.

.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* --- Reference: ZTC diode-connected NMOS (VREF on IBN2U) ----------------
XMR IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3.0 w=0.42 nf=1

* --- Bias for PMOS current source (VBP) ---------------------------------
* NMOS mirror: 2uA reference -> 1uA into the PMOS diode
XMN1 PBIAS IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=0.42 nf=1
* PMOS diode establishes VBP
XMPD PBIAS PBIAS AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=0.84 nf=1

* --- Charge current source (1 uA into CAP) ------------------------------
XMPC CAP PBIAS AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=0.84 nf=1

* --- Timing capacitor (MIM) ---------------------------------------------
XCAP CAP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=17 l=16

* --- Comparator: NMOS diff pair + PMOS mirror load ----------------------
* Tail current source (1 uA, mirrored from VREF)
XMTAIL TAIL IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=0.42 nf=1
* Input pair: M1 gate=CAP (output side), M2 gate=VREF (diode-load side)
XM1 CO CAP TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=1
XM2 D1 IBN2U TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=1
* Active load
XMP3 D1 D1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP4 CO D1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=1

* --- Reset: inverter (CO -> RST), reset NMOS discharges CAP -------------
XINP RST CO AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XINN RST CO AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMRST CAP RST AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=2

* --- Output buffer (RST -> CLKO), drives 1 pF ---------------------------
XBUFN CLKO RST AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XBUFP CLKO RST AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2

.ends osc_2m

circuit:
* 2 MHz current-controlled relaxation oscillator (Sky130).
* Frequency is set by a physical R*C product: f = 1 / (2 * R2 * C).
* The same mirrored bias current both charges the timing capacitor and
* generates the V_lo / V_hi comparison window, so the current cancels and
* the frequency is first-order independent of supply and process.
*
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* ---- bias ----
* MN0: diode-connected NMOS receives the 2 uA bias input (nbias = IBN2U node).
XMN0   IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4
* PB branch: 1 uA mirrored through PMOS diode MP0 (sets pbias).
XMP0   PB PB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=6
XMN0B  PB IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2

* ---- reference window: V_lo = I*R1, V_hi = I*(R1+R2) ----
XMPREF VTOP PB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=6
XR2    VTOP VMID AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.84 l=1059
XR1    VMID AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.84 l=2117

* ---- timing capacitor ----
XCM    VC AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=15 l=20

* ---- charge / discharge steering (both switches gated by Q) ----
XMPCHG VCHG PB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=6
XMPCSW VC Q VCHG AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2
XMNCHG VDIS IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2
XMNSW  VC Q VDIS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2

* ---- comparators (out high when inn > inp) ----
XCHI   VC VTOP SHI AVDD AVSS IBN2U cmp
XCLO   VMID VC SLO AVDD AVSS IBN2U cmp

* ---- SR latch (active-high: SHI sets Q=1, SLO resets Q=0) ----
XNOR1 SLO QB Q AVDD AVSS nor2
XNOR2 SHI Q QB AVDD AVSS nor2

* ---- output buffer ----
XINV1  Q QN AVDD AVSS inv_s
XINV2  QN CLKO AVDD AVSS inv_big

.ends osc_2m

* NMOS-input comparator with resistor load (no mirror node).
* The tail current flows through the two high-poly load resistors, so the
* balanced output sits at VDD - (Itail/2)*R ~ VDD/2 (matched to the inverter
* trip => near-zero systematic offset in every corner).  With no current
* mirror there is no slow diode-node pole: the only pole is R*C_out, and the
* slow input ramp lets the output track quasi-statically, so comparator delay
* is just the two inverter stages.  out = high when inn > inp.
.subckt cmp inn inp out vdd vss nbias
XMN1 da inn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMN2 db inp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMNT tail nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2
XRL1 vdd da vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.84 l=4763
XRL2 vdd db vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.84 l=4763
XINVA db dbn vdd vss inv_s
XINVB dbn out vdd vss inv_s
.ends cmp

* 2-input NOR gate (out = ~(a | b)).
.subckt nor2 a b y vdd vss
XMPA n1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2
XMPB y b n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2
XMNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
XMN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
.ends nor2

* Small inverter.
.subckt inv_s in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
.ends inv_s

* Large inverter (output driver).
.subckt inv_big in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3
.ends inv_big

circuit:
* 2 MHz current-starved ring oscillator
* Bias leg current is split between:
*   - bus PNA: diode NMOS fed by the external fixed 2 uA at IBN2U
*   - bus PNB: diode NMOS fed from AVDD through a physical poly resistor,
*     so its current ~ (VDD-Vgs)/R tracks supply and compensates the 1/VDD
*     dependence of the current-starved ring period.
* A PMOS diode reference branch mirrors the combined current into the ring
* pull-up heads. Seven identical starved inverter stages form the ring,
* each loaded by a MIM capacitor, followed by a three-instance output
* buffer chain driving CLKO.
.subckt ring_stage AVDD AVSS IN OUT PGP PNA PNB
* Pull-up: PMOS current source (gate PGP) and PMOS switch
XPH AVDD PGP SGP AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.4
XPS SGP IN OUT AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4
* Pull-down: NMOS switch and two parallel tail sources (buses PNA, PNB)
XNS OUT IN SGN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
XTNA SGN PNA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.42
XTNB SGN PNB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.68
* Timing capacitor
XCC OUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5.9 l=5.9
.ends ring_stage

.subckt buf_s AVDD AVSS IN OUT
XP AVDD IN OUT AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4
XN OUT IN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
.ends buf_s

.subckt buf_m AVDD AVSS IN OUT
XP AVDD IN OUT AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2
XN OUT IN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5
.ends buf_m

.subckt buf_l AVDD AVSS IN OUT
XP AVDD IN OUT AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=14
XN OUT IN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=6
.ends buf_l

.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U
* --- Fixed 2 uA bias mirror (bus PNA = IBN2U) ---
XNA IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.84
* --- Supply-tracking resistor-fed diode (bus PNB = NBR) ---
XRB AVDD NBR AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=1190
XNB NBR NBR AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.84
* --- PMOS diode reference: combined 2 uA through diode PMOS ---
XPR AVDD PGP PGP AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.4
XNRA PGP IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.42
XNRB PGP NBR AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.68
* --- Seven-stage ring ---
XS1 AVDD AVSS N7 N1 PGP IBN2U NBR ring_stage
XS2 AVDD AVSS N1 N2 PGP IBN2U NBR ring_stage
XS3 AVDD AVSS N2 N3 PGP IBN2U NBR ring_stage
XS4 AVDD AVSS N3 N4 PGP IBN2U NBR ring_stage
XS5 AVDD AVSS N4 N5 PGP IBN2U NBR ring_stage
XS6 AVDD AVSS N5 N6 PGP IBN2U NBR ring_stage
XS7 AVDD AVSS N6 N7 PGP IBN2U NBR ring_stage
* --- Output buffer chain ---
XB1 AVDD AVSS N1 NB1 buf_s
XB2 AVDD AVSS NB1 NB2 buf_m
XB3 AVDD AVSS NB2 CLKO buf_l
.ends osc_2m

circuit:
* 2 MHz low-power current-starved ring oscillator
* Pins: AVDD supply, AVSS ground, CLKO output (drives ~1pF), IBN2U 2uA bias sink
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* ---- Bias: fixed 2uA domain (from IBN2U) ----
* Diode reference carries the bench 2uA; IBN2U is the n-side gate bias.
XMBN  IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=2.5 nf=1
* Fixed p-side gate generator: mirror nfet + diode pfet (half ratio).
XMNPF VPF   IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=0.5 nf=1

circuit:
* 2 MHz coarse RC oscillator (classic two-gate astable multivibrator)
*
* Two inverters form a non-inverting loop.  R connects the input (A) of the
* first inverter to its output (NR), and C couples A to the second inverter
* output (CLKO).  At each flip the full rail jump of CLKO is coupled onto A,
* after which R slews A back to the first-inverter threshold.  Both the
* starting kick and the threshold scale with VDD, so the period is
* independent of supply: T = R*C*(ln(1+k*VDD/Vm)+ln(1+k*VDD/(VDD-Vm)))
* ~ 2.2*R*C, and is first-order insensitive to the inverter threshold Vm.
* The high-poly resistor and MIM capacitor models sit at their typical
* corner in every MOS .lib section; only their temperature coefficients move
* them (net ~ +5e-4/K), so frequency spread over the declared PVT points
* stays well inside +/-10%.
*
* First inverter: slightly oversized so its output rails against the timing
* resistor and snaps over quickly (keeps the second inverter's crowbar short).
.subckt osc_inv A Z VDD VSS
XN Z A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP Z A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends osc_inv
*
* Second inverter: stronger, drives the timing capacitor plus the 1 pF load.
.subckt osc_inv_drv A Z VDD VSS
XN Z A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XP Z A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
.ends osc_inv_drv
*
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U
* Absorb the external 2 uA bias current with a diode-connected NMOS.
XMB IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
*
* Astable timing loop: G1 (NR) -> G2 (CLKO), R: A-NR, C: A-CLKO.
XG1 A NR AVDD AVSS osc_inv
XG2 NR CLKO AVDD AVSS osc_inv_drv
XR  A NR AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=2050
XC  A CLKO sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=13 l=13 mf=1
.ends osc_2m

* 2 MHz low-power relaxation oscillator, Sky130 transistor level.
*
* 555-style: a MIM timing capacitor ramps between ratiometric
* thresholds TLO = 0.4*AVDD and THI = 0.6*AVDD through poly resistors
* steered by MOS switches.  Two tail-biased differential comparators
* (no shoot-through) detect the thresholds, an SR NOR latch holds the
* state, and an inverter chain buffers CLKO.  Frequency is set by the
* poly-R / MIM-C product; thresholds are ratiometric and R/C use the
* typical model at every MOS corner.
*
* Local building blocks.
.subckt inv avdd avss in out
XMP out in avdd avdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN out in avss avss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends inv
.subckt nor2 avdd avss a b out
XMPA out a avdd avdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMPB out b avdd avdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMNA out a n1 avss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMNB n1 b avss avss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends nor2
* Differential comparator: out = high when inp > inn.
* NMOS lvt input pair, NMOS tail (gate = vbn), PMOS mirror load,
* output inverter for rail-to-rail swing.
.subckt comp avdd avss vbn inp inn out
XMT  vsrc vbn avss avss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMN1 d1 inn vsrc avss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XMN2 d2 inp vsrc avss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XMP1 d1 d1 avdd avdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP2 d2 d1 avdd avdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.68 nf=2
XMPI out d2 avdd avdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMNI out d2 avss avss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends comp
.subckt buf1 avdd avss in out
XMP out in avdd avdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=3
XMN out in avss avss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends buf1
.subckt buf2 avdd avss in out
XMP out in avdd avdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=7
XMN out in avss avss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=3
.ends buf2
*
* ---- Oscillator top level ----
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U
* 2 uA reference sink; gate biases comparator tails
XMD IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
*
* Ratiometric threshold ladder: 5 equal poly segments AVDD -> AVSS.
* THI = 0.6*AVDD, TLO = 0.4*AVDD (ratios, so R tempco is irrelevant).
XRA AVDD N8  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=200
XRB N8   THI AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=200
XRC THI  TLO AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=200
XRD TLO  N2  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=200
XRE N2   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=200
*
* Timing capacitor (MIM, zero tempco) on ramp node
XCT CAP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=18 l=18
*
* Ramp steering: charge AVDD-RUP-PMOS-CAP, discharge CAP-NMOS-RDN-AVSS
XRUP AVDD RUPX AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=2500
XRDN RDNX AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=2500
XMPU RUPX Q CAP AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=3
XMND CAP Q RDNX AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2

* 2 MHz low-power relaxation oscillator - Sky130
*
* Architecture: resistor-charged relaxation oscillator.
*   AVDD --Rchg-- VCAP (MIM cap to AVSS): VCAP charges exponentially toward AVDD.
*   A poly resistor divider generates VTAP = k*AVDD (ratio-accurate, tracks VDD).
*   A 5T OTA (NMOS diff pair, PMOS current-mirror load) compares VCAP against
*   VTAP. Its output N1 is rail-to-rail by construction: whichever branch wins
*   starves the other, so no inverter trip point has to be aligned to an
*   intermediate level.
*   N1 inverted drives an NMOS switch that shorts VCAP to AVSS.
*
*   t_charge = Rchg*Ct*ln(1/(1-k))  ->  depends only on R, C and the resistor
*   ratio k. No MOS current, threshold or gain appears in the timing expression,
*   so the frequency tracks only the R*C tempco and the divider ratio.

.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* ---- bias: diode-connected NMOS sinks the forced 2 uA; mirrored to the tail ----
XMB    IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6 nf=2

* ---- timing capacitor ----
XCT    VCAP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=5 mf=10

* ---- charge resistor ----
XRC    AVDD VCAP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.35 l=3800

* ---- threshold divider: VTAP = 0.65 * AVDD ----
XRD1   AVDD VTAP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.35 l=2675
XRD2   VTAP AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.35 l=4968

* ---- comparator: NMOS pair, PMOS current-mirror load, rail-to-rail output ----
XMA    NA    VTAP  NTAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2
XMB2   N1    VCAP  NTAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2
XTAIL  NTAIL IBN2U AVSS  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.8 nf=1
XPDA   NA    NA    AVDD  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XPDB   N1    NA    AVDD  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* ---- inverter: N1 -> NC ----
XMP1   NC N1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN1   NC N1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* ---- reset switch: shorts VCAP to AVSS ----
XRSW   VCAP NC AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2

* ---- output buffer ----
XMP2   ND NC AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
XMN2   ND NC AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMP3   CLKO ND AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.0 nf=2
XMN3   CLKO ND AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2

.ends osc_2m

circuit:
* 2 MHz low-power RC relaxation oscillator -- Sky130 PDK
*
* Interface: .subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U
*
* Topology (astable multivibrator, no comparator or latch required):
*
*   VCAP ---- C(mim) ---- AVSS
*    |  \
*    |   R_osc (temp-compensated poly) ---- OSC   (digital drive node)
*    |
*    R_in
*    |
*   NA ----[inv]---- OUT ----[inv]---- OUTB
*    |                                 |
*    +--------- R_fb ----------------- +
*
*   NA = VCAP*g + OUTB*(1-g) with g = R_fb/(R_in+R_fb).
*   OUTB is the complement of OUT, so the inverter's threshold is crossed at
*     VCAP = Vt/g          while charging  (OUTB = 0)
*     VCAP = Vt/g - m*VDD  while discharging (OUTB = VDD),  m = R_in/R_fb
*   The trip window is exactly m*VDD and its centre tracks Vt/g, so the
*   period is T = R_osc*C*ln[(1-k_lo)*k_hi/((1-k_hi)*k_lo)] with k = Vtrip/VDD.
*   Because the two thresholds are a VDD-ratio window centred on VDD/2, the
*   bracketed constant is nearly invariant across supply and temperature, and
*   the frequency is set by R_osc*C alone.
*
*   R_osc, R_in and R_fb are each built as a series pair of res_high_po
*   (tc1 = +0.51e-3) and res_xhigh_po (tc1 = -1.47e-3).  With ~75% of the
*   resistance in the high_po section the composite tempco is ~0, so R*C is
*   flat over -40 C to 85 C.  The MIM capacitor has tc1 = tc2 = 0.

* ---- local helpers -------------------------------------------------------

* Comparator inverter: Wp/Wn chosen so Vt/VDD ~ 0.50, which centres the
* hysteresis window on VDD/2 and minimises the sensitivity of the period.
.subckt osc_inv in out vh vl
XMP out in vh vh sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMN out in vl vl sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends osc_inv

* Small inverter for the complementary drive node
.subckt osc_invs in out vh vl
XMP out in vh vh sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XMN out in vl vl sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends osc_invs

* Output driver for the 1 pF external load
.subckt osc_buf in out vh vl
XMP out in vh vh sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=3
XMN out in vl vl sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=3
.ends osc_buf

* ---- top level -----------------------------------------------------------

.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* Sink the external 2 uA bias input (IBN2U is driven from the supply path).
XMN_B IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1

* Timing network: R_osc from the drive node OUT to VCAP, C at VCAP.
XR_O0 OUT VCAP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po  w=0.35 l=300
XR_O1 OUT VCAP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=13.2
XC_M VCAP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22.2 l=22.2 mf=1

* Hysteresis divider: R_in from VCAP to NA, R_fb from NA to OUTB.
XR_I0 VCAP NA AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po  w=0.35 l=270
XR_I1 VCAP NA AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=11.9
XR_F0 NA OUTB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po  w=0.35 l=902
XR_F1 NA OUTB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=39.4

* Hysteresis loop
XIA NA OUT AVDD AVSS osc_inv
XIB OUT OUTB AVDD AVSS osc_invs

* Output stage (CLKO is in phase with OUT)
XIC CLKO OUTB AVDD AVSS osc_buf

.ends osc_2m

circuit:
* =====================================================================
*  osc_2m : 2 MHz low-power relaxation oscillator, Sky130 PDK
*
*  The 2 uA bias entering IBN2U sets an NMOS mirror diode (VBN).  That
*  current is replicated into
*    - a poly resistor string that fixes the two comparator thresholds
*      (VLO = Iw*Rc, VHI = Iw*(Rc+Rb)), and
*    - the charge / discharge currents of the timing capacitor,
*  so the period  T = C*(VHI-VLO)*(1/Ic + 1/Idis)  depends only on the
*  MIM capacitor, the poly resistor and mirror geometry ratios.  The
*  discharge sink is permanently biased from VBN (no switched path ever
*  loads the master bias node) and only the charge source is steered.
* =====================================================================

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  local cells
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt inv a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends inv

* PMOS-strong inverter: threshold above mid rail, squares up the
* comparator core output.
.subckt invh a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends invh

.subckt nand2 a b y vdd vss
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XN1 n1 a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XN2 y b n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt invout a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
.ends invout

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  comparator: NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load, PMOS-strong buffer.
*  out rises when vnb > vna.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt cmp vdd vss ibn vna vnb out
XT  sn ibn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=2.4 nf=1
X1  nout vna sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1
X2  nm   vnb sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1
XL1 nm nm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=3 nf=1
XL2 nout nm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=3 nf=1
XB  out nout vdd vss invh
.ends cmp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  top level
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

* 2 uA bias input -> NMOS mirror reference (VBN = IBN2U)
XMN0 IBN2U IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=8 nf=2

* NMOS sense branch feeds the PMOS reference diode (VBP = NBP)
XMN1 NBP IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=3.2 nf=1
XMP0 NBP NBP AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=4 nf=1

* threshold string:  AVDD -> XMPW -> VHI --Rb-- VLO --Rc-- AVSS
XMPW VHI NBP AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=1
XW1  VHI VLO AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.35 l=383.6
XW2  VLO AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.35 l=1090.5

* timing capacitor
XCC VC AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=18.8 l=18.8 mf=1

* discharge sink: permanently biased from VBN
XMND VC IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=4 nf=1

* charge source: gate steered between VBP (on) and AVDD (off)
XMPC VC GBC AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1
XMP2 GBC Q  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMP1 GBC QB NBP AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* window comparators
*   SL = (VC > VLO)   latch set   (active low) -> Q=1 charge
*   SH = (VC < VHI)   latch reset (active low) -> Q=0 discharge
XCL AVDD AVSS IBN2U VLO VC SL cmp
XCH AVDD AVSS IBN2U VC VHI SH cmp

* SR latch (NAND based)
XG1 Q  QB SL AVDD AVSS nand2
XG2 QB Q  SH AVDD AVSS nand2

* output driver
XB1 NQ  Q  AVDD AVSS inv
XB2 NQ2 NQ AVDD AVSS inv
XB3 CLKO NQ2 AVDD AVSS invout

.ends osc_2m

* 2 MHz low-power relaxation oscillator.
* Servo amps force vr = 2VDD/3 and vb = VDD/3 across poly resistor R1,
* so I = VDD/(3*R1). Timing cap Ct is charged/discharged by matched
* copies of I between VDD/3 and 2VDD/3, giving f = 1/(2*R1*Ct), supply
* independent; PVT dependence enters mainly via R1 (poly, low TC) and
* Ct (MIM, ~zero TC). The external 2 uA on IBN2U is sunk by a diode
* device and also seeds the internal bias voltages.

.subckt osc_2m AVDD AVSS CLKO IBN2U

XMNI vbp IBN2U AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=2
XMBP vbp vbp AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.8 nf=2

* --- reference divider: t1 = VDD/3, t3 = 2VDD/3 -------------------------
XRD3 AVDD t3 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=9451
XRD2 t3 t1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=9451
XRD1 t1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=9451

* --- timing resistor: I = VDD/(3*R1), f = 1/(2*R1*Ct) -------------------
XR1 vr vb AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=1922

* --- reference branch and its current mirrors ----------------------------
* AVDD - P1 - vr - R1 - vb - N1 - AVSS, servoed to VDD/3 across R1.

XN1  vb gn AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=2
* Charge device (copy of P1) and discharge device (copy of N1).
XP2  nc ga AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2

XSA2T s2 vbp AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XSA2L dl2 vb s2 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XSA2R gn t1 s2 AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XSA2ND dl2 dl2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XSA2NS gn dl2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
